entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: An information element that the network may include to request a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed.

entities.name: Procedure retry
entities.description: A procedure that may be retried by the UE after a minimum time interval specified by the back-off timer value.

entities.name: Minimum time interval before retry
entities.description: A condition requiring that procedure retry is not allowed until the minimum time interval specified by the back-off timer value has elapsed.

relations.description: The back-off timer value IE establishes the condition that a minimum time interval must pass before procedure retry is allowed.
The minimum time interval condition guards the procedure retry by preventing it from occurring until the interval has elapsed.
